description: Source code for the HpackEncoder class implementing HPACK header compression for HTTP/2, including header encoding, table size management, and header representation iteration.

classes.name: HpackEncoder::RepresentationIterator
classes.description: Iterator over header representations, separating pseudo-headers and regular headers.

classes.name: HpackEncoder::Encoderator
classes.description: Encodes header representations iteratively, supporting partial encoding.

methods.name: HpackEncoder::EncodeHeaderBlock
methods.description: Encodes a set of HTTP/2 headers into HPACK format.

methods.name: HpackEncoder::ApplyHeaderTableSizeSetting
methods.description: Updates the header table size setting and triggers emission if needed.

methods.name: HpackEncoder::EncodeRepresentations
methods.description: Encodes header representations using an iterator.

methods.name: HpackEncoder::CookieToCrumbs
methods.description: Splits cookie header value into multiple HPACK representations.

methods.name: HpackEncoder::DecomposeRepresentation
methods.description: Splits header field value into multiple parts based on null character.

methods.name: HpackEncoder::Encoderator::Next
methods.description: Encodes and returns up to max_encoded_bytes of headers.
